messages.text: Core outputs now match on the baseline cases. I’m tightening table alignment, frequency ordering, null handling, and expensive stats fields with the upstream fixtures.

commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess,pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
pathlib.Path('table.csv').write_text('h1,h2,h3\\nabcdefg,a,a\\na,abc,z\\n',newline='')
pathlib.Path('freq.csv').write_text('h1,h2\\na,z\\na,y\\na,y\\nb,z\\n,z\\n(NULL),x\\n',newline='')
cases=[['count','sample.csv'],['headers','sample.csv'],['table','sample.csv'],['table','table.csv'],['frequency','--limit','0','sample.csv'],['frequency','--limit','1','freq.csv'],['frequency','--asc','--limit','1','--select','h2','freq.csv'],['frequency','--no-nulls','--limit','0','--select','h1','freq.csv'],['stats','--everything','sample.csv'],['select','3-1','sample.csv'],['select','"'!1'"','sample.csv'],['slice','-s','1','-e','3','sample.csv'],['fmt','--crlf','sample.csv']]
for argv in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref,*argv],capture_output=True);p=subprocess.run(['python','xsv_port.py',*argv],capture_output=True)
 ok=(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)==(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'BAD'),argv)
 if not ok: print('R',repr(r.stdout),repr(r.stderr),r.returncode,'\\nP',repr(p.stdout),repr(p.stderr),p.returncode)
'@ | python -; python -m py_compile .\\xsv_port.py; cmd /c .\\executable.cmd count sample.csv"
